title: Sir Thomas Roe at Jahangir's court (1615)
script: In sixteen fifteen, King James the First sends Sir Thomas Roe to India. After months at sea, he lands at Surat, then rides inland to the court of Emperor Jahangir. The emperor is one of the richest rulers on earth, and he keeps the envoy waiting for years. In the end, Roe wins trading rights at Surat. The Company's foothold is set.
